review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md and README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md, WORKFLOW.md, and tools/autopilot/AUDIT.md read for repository and rendering-audit context.

review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot, byte-compared with current source, and checked against the assigned local HTML, capture receipt, and individually viewed screenshot tiles.

findings.kind: Young diagram with highlighted removable rim hooks and resulting subshapes
findings.rationale: The worked example’s central calculations are two legal 5-strip removals, their signs/heights and child shapes, followed by the unique 7-strip removal. These geometric relations are currently described only in prose and coordinate lists; a single labelled Young diagram would make the Murnaghan–Nakayama recursion easier to verify.
findings.concrete_content: Draw shape (5,4,4). Highlight the two disjoint removable 5-rim hooks listed at source line 63 and label their complements (3,3,2), height 2/sign +, and (5,3), height 1/sign −. Highlight the unique 7-rim hook in line 65 and label its complement (3,3), height 2/sign +. Keep the proof independent of the diagram.
findings.render_observation: No existing TikZ diagram; the item’s text and formulas render without receipt-reported errors or clipping.
